title: Scheduled DCS2 solute-threshold overirrigation composition

equations: the concentration threshold and overirrigation percentage inputs are each bounded from 0 to 100
only when both solute switches are enabled, if cml(nodsen) > cirrthres then irr_depth += 0.01*perirrsurp*irr_depth
the strict concentration comparison follows the base-depth and optional min/max logic and precedes rate/duration materialization

scope: compose the B1 dual-switch strict concentration gate with the existing scheduled DCS2 AFGEN depth path
materialize the resulting event through the existing scheduled SSDI evaluator while preserving its one-node water-source vector
100000 deterministic event compositions covering above/equal/below threshold and one-switch-disabled cases
validate finite threshold/sensor input and the B1 threshold/percentage bounds
non_goals: DCS1 depth integration, rain correction, min/max limit integration or over-one-day legacy rate fallback
input parsing, calendar, solute transport/mass booking, accepted soil flux, restart or production admission
event-duration cases over the current typed evaluator one-day limit
pass_conditions: only both enabled switches plus strict sensor-concentration exceedance adjust depth
percentage adjustment occurs before rate/duration and offered source amount calculation
100000 deterministic events pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts and unchanged SSDI node/rate vector
invalid thresholds, percentages and active sensor concentration fail closed
